mapper.select: select api.BENCH_DATE benchDate, sum(apd.PLAN_TARGET_AMT) planTargetSum from PRD_PLAN_INFO api inner join PRD_PLAN_DETAIL apd on api.PRD_PLAN_CODE = apd.PRD_PLAN_CODE where DATE_FORMAT(api.VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = #{vdate} AND DATE_FORMAT(api.EDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = #{edate} group by api.VDATE, api.EDATE, api.BENCH_DATE
